additional_info.subject: RE: ID0466442-DC/Si-D/CH-[MP / R7 170002200] Short Charger Issue CRM:03055000423
additional_info.body:
Dear Alexander,
I am reaching out in regards of the SLA ticket
ID0466442.
Thank you for raising the ticket. I had a quick look at the #3 sessions highlighted, and these are my findings:
The session on 08.12.2025 is a low energy session due to a bug of the charger. During the charging session, an error on the LEM triggers an OCPPStopTransaction, which is accepted, but the session in reality goes on. This bug has already been addressed by R&D, and a fix is already included in the recently released
FW v8.1.4.
Please proceed to update the charger at v8.1.4 as soon as possible.
For the session on 07.12.2025 I saw many RemoteStartTransaction messages on the same outlet, which might have stopped the session. I will analyze it more in depth and provide you with a feedback as soon as posisble.
For the session on 06.12.2025, also here we have the same behavior as for the first case. An error on the LEM triggers an OCPPStopTransaction, which is accepted, but the session in reality goes on
Please proceed to update the charger MP / R7 170002200 to FW v8.1.4 as soon as possible. I will follow up on the second failed session shortly.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0466442-DC/Si-D/CH-[MP / R7 170002200] Short Charger Issue CRM:03055000423
additional_info.body:
Dear Alexander,
I
am following up on ticket
ID0466442.
Here is a complete analysis of the sessions reported by you:
(As per previous email)
The session on 08.12.2025 is a low energy session due to a bug of the charger. During the charging session, an error on the LEM triggers an OCPPStopTransaction, which is accepted, but the session in reality goes on. This bug has already been addressed by R&D, and a fix is already included in the recently released
FW v8.1.4.
Please proceed to update the charger at v8.1.4 as soon as possible.
For the session on 07.12.2025 also in this case the session was short from Backend side due to the LEM errror:
(As per previous email)
For the session on 06.12.2025, also here we have the same behavior as for the first case. An error on the LEM triggers an OCPP StopTransaction, which is accepted, but the session in reality goes on
In conclusion, all three sessions were reported as short sessions due to this error on the LEM, which is solved in
FW v8.1.4.
It is necessary then to update the charger to
v8.1.4
as soon as possible. The charger is currently running on v7.0.5, and v8.0.5 already rolled out. It is necessary  to update first to v8.0.5, rollout v8.1.4, and then update again.
Should I proceed to update the charger to v8.1.4 during office hours, or will you take care to launch the update on SCB?
Please let me know if you need support to update the charger. I will then proceed to close the ticket, as the analysis has been provided and the bug and bugfix communicated.
Looking forward to hearing feedback from you soon!
